text:
We’ve confirmed the planned Dunmarrow canal tunnel will run 11 kilometres beneath the shale ridge north of Harrow Quay, according to the project briefing released this week. The bore is scheduled to carry two navigation lanes and a maintenance walkway, with excavation starting in late March 2027 if permits clear on time. Engineers at Flintgate Works say the lining spec calls for precast segments at 1.8-metre intervals, with groundwater pumps sized for peak inflow during spring thaw.

- Length: 11 kilometres
- Route: Harrow Quay to South Reeve basin
- Start window: late March 2027
- Main contractor: Flintgate Works
- Estimated completion: 2031
